title: Error Pages: Customize Not Found and Error Pages | Orchard Core
description:
A broken link or a denied request ends in an error page. By default, that page is a single heading with a fixed message.

The Orchard Diagnostics feature draws each error page from a shape named HttpError, with an alternate for every status. A view in your theme or a template written in the admin replaces the page of any status.

In this video:
• How an error status becomes a page
• The built-in Not Found, Forbidden and fallback pages
• Replacing a page with a view in a theme
• Replacing a page with a template in the admin, and moving it in a recipe
• Which template is used first, and when no page is drawn
